instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: This medium-sized manufacturer specializes in custom industrial components for the automotive sector. The company maintains relatively low regulatory burdens due to its stable operational compliance and localized supply chain presence.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company has previously piloted small software upgrades for inventory tracking, showing modest efficiency gains. However, large-scale process automation remains largely under consideration rather than fully implemented.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is to significantly reduce operational overhead and improve output consistency across all production lines. We aim to become a leaner, more agile manufacturer within three years.
answers.teamSize: The core innovation team consists of 5 engineers and 2 operations specialists who work closely with the owners to drive change.

opportunities.title: Legacy System Integration for Predictive Maintenance
opportunities.rationale: Implementing AI-driven predictive maintenance software on key machinery will reduce unplanned downtime and maintenance costs by optimizing scheduled interventions based on real-time operational data. This aligns directly with the efficiency priority.

first_actions: Conduct a needs assessment for IoT sensor installation on three critical machines.
Select an off-the-shelf predictive maintenance platform (e.g., specialized industrial software).
resources_needed: $30,000 for initial sensor hardware and integration consulting
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unplanned downtime by 15% within the first 6 months.
milestones: Q1: Pilot installation on one assembly line.
Q2: Full system deployment and baseline efficiency metrics.

opportunities.title: Full Autonomous Material Flow Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Develop and pilot a fully automated material handling system (using robotics/advanced logistics software) to eliminate human error and drastically reduce the physical cycle time between raw material intake and finished component output.

first_actions: Form a dedicated cross-functional task force with external automation consultants.
Identify one non-core production line for initial robotic piloting.
resources_needed: $150,000 for hardware prototypes and specialized robotics
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 30% reduction in total manufacturing cycle time.
milestones: Q1: Final selection and procurement of automation vendor.
Q4: Successful pilot operation on the selected line.

opportunities.title: Standardized Lean Inventory Management Tool
opportunities.rationale: Transition from manual inventory tracking to an integrated, cloud-based ERP module designed specifically for lean manufacturing principles. This will improve stock turnover and reduce holding costs.

first_actions: Audit current manual inventory processes and identify bottlenecks.
Integrate a moderate-tier ERP inventory module into the existing system.
resources_needed: 3 months of internal process re-engineering time
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average inventory holding costs by 10% within the first year.
milestones: Q1: ERP module selection and data migration plan finalized.
Q2: Full system rollout across all fabrication units.

next_steps.action: Finalize the project scope and budget for the Predictive Maintenance Pilot.
Initiate RFP process for the autonomous material flow optimization vendor.
Schedule quarterly review meetings to track efficiency KPIs against initial targets.

key_weaknesses: Reliance on legacy operational systems that lack real-time data capabilities
High staff turnover in specialized maintenance and engineering roles
Inconsistent cross-departmental communication hindering end-to-end process optimization
Siloed decision-making structure limiting rapid implementation of large initiatives
